Class Command

java.lang.Object
commands.Command
Direct Known Subclasses:
DebugCommand, EnvironmentCommand, RobotCommand, SimulationCommand
public abstract class Command extends Object
Abstract base class for all commands in the simulation.

This abstract class defines the common interface and behavior for various command types. Concrete commands should extend this class and implement the execute(Simulation) method
